title: Chapter 1214
text:
Swoosh!

With a flash of light, a slightly expanded King mechanical suit suddenly appeared in the warehouse of the Superpower Security Department, instantly blowing up the safe. The next moment, the mechanical suit automatically removed itself, revealing the figures of the three of them.

Han Xiao casually retrieved the throne and looked at the environment.

The three of them were in a separate warehouse. In front of them was a transparent high-strength material wall, and they could see rows of warehouses outside. A small part of them was empty, and most of them contained different collections.

"The Family Change Tactic is still as useful as ever." Han Xiao clicked his tongue.

"Looks like we're here. What's next?" Kasuyi rubbed his eyebrows. He felt that he could no longer hold back his accumulated psychic power and could spurt it out at any time.

Jayz looked at the code of the warehouse outside and said, "This is warehouse area 117. The closest dimensional consciousness carrier to us is in area 106."

At this moment, a shrill alarm suddenly sounded, echoing throughout the warehouse.

The next moment, new alloy walls were lowered in all the warehouses. The material was opaque, blocking vision, and at the same time, the defensive strength was higher.

"The alarm has been triggered. The warehouse will be immediately locked down, and the automatic defense robots will be activated to besiege us. At the same time, the important collections will be transported away through the pipeline for emergency evacuation."

Jayz was not surprised at all. With a wave of his hand, a virtual screen appeared in front of him. He quickly operated it and casually said,

"I just used the backdoor code to cancel the emergency evacuation program of the collection, so there's no need to worry about the carrier being transferred. However, the changes here will definitely alarm the people at headquarters, and those Supers on standby will rush over. We don't have much time."

"Then, let's hurry up."

Han Xiao nodded, turned around, and swung his leg. With a boom, metal fragments scattered like flowers, and the warehouse wall was smashed to pieces.

The three of them moved quickly, rushing toward their destination under the shrill alarm.

Along the way, the floor and walls kept sliding open, revealing the automatic defense mechanisms within. Countless multi-barreled turrets opened fire at the three of them. Numerous small-caliber dark energy beams formed dark-red chains of light, which chased after the three of them.

Han Xiao maintained a thick psionic shield, and the dark energy beams rained down on it like a rainstorm. They only created circles of red and blue ripples on the surface of the shield, which looked like water droplets falling into a lake. It was not very powerful. However, this was only because the strength of the shield was too high. When some of the light beams missed and hit the metal floor or walls, the terrifying heat would instantly melt them, turning them into molten metal. Then, there would be an explosion of dark energy that was so dense that it was almost tangible. Everywhere the three of them passed, there would be a mess.

Due to the lack of a secondary dimension, psionic energy could not be extracted there. However, the mechanical troops that Han Xiao had brought in were all equipped with psionic energy reactors. Through the splitting and devouring characteristics of psionic energy, more controllable psionic energy seeds could be created. There was no need to collect them through secondary dimensions. Thus, Han Xiao's energy intensity had a certain inherent advantage here.

The automatic defense mechanism could not stop the three of them. The three of them broke through the layers of obstacles and continued to approach Warehouse 106.

At this moment, the three of them sensed two powerful individuals rapidly approaching. With a loud bang, two burly figures broke through the wall, exuding a powerful pugilist aura.

These two pugilists locked onto the three of them and madly charged, accompanied by a furious roar.

"How dare you sneak attack the headquarters of the Superpower Security Department! You are guilty of the most heinous crimes! "

Jayz glanced at them and quickly said, "Under normal circumstances, there will be one to three experts above the Saint level guarding the warehouse on a daily basis, adopting a shift system. These two should be the guardians, so they came the fastest. It will take some time for the others to arrive from the headquarters. Don't get entangled with them."

Hearing this, Kasuyi did not say a word. He aimed at the two of them and poured out his inventory.

Boom!

A circle of psychic shockwaves shook from under his feet, followed by an extraordinary psychic force shooting out. Ordinary psychic forces were mostly invisible and formless, but this psychic force shot out by Kasuyi was extremely condensed, shining with a dazzling light. It was so condensed that it was solid and extremely powerful, like a beam of light. Even the surrounding space was distorted, instantly swallowing the figures of the two pugilists.

This psychic force was like a black hole with infinite gravity. Just by standing next to it, Han Xiao could feel a strange mental suction force, as if it was trying to drag his soul away. One could imagine how the two Saint level Pugilists felt when they were hit head-on.

Puchi!

The sound of a balloon being popped sounded on the mental level, penetrating deep into the soul and echoing endlessly.

Han Xiao took a closer look and saw that the two Pugilists had collapsed on the road. Their bodies were twitching, and they could not get up. Their mouths and noses were like open faucets, with red and white blood flowing out. Even their brains had been shaken out of their bodies.

"Their consciousness has been shattered by me, and they won't be able to recover in a short time." Kasuyi emptied his inventory and only felt comfortable all over.

"Good job." Han Xiao gave him a thumbs up.

As expected of someone who had held it in for a few months. The impact was strong enough, and it was even seasoned. With just one shot, two ordinary Beyond Grade As had lost their combat strength.

If not for the fact that mental attacks had limited effect on dimensional consciousness entities, Kasuyi would have wanted to save this trump card for the guardian's main body. Furthermore, Han Xiao and Jayz's bodies were filled with the Mech Legion, so their health and energy were suppressed. Only he maintained his full combat strength and could end the battle as quickly as possible.

On the other side, the headquarters of the Superpower Security Department was already fully operational. All the upper echelons urgently entered the encrypted communication channel, sharing the surveillance footage of the warehouse area. Everyone was shocked and angry.

They did not expect that these three daring criminals would actually use some kind of strange teleportation method to directly attack their headquarters!

From the first day of the Superpower Security Department's establishment, this was the first time someone had attacked the headquarters!

While everyone was furious, they also felt deeply confused.

This group of people had lured the tiger away from the mountain and spent so much effort to attack the headquarters. What was their goal? It seemed like they wanted to steal something from the warehouse?

"No matter what the other party's goal is, we must not let them succeed!" Everyone had the same determination.

Many of the powerhouses in the headquarters rushed to the warehouse at full speed. When they saw the two warehouse guardians appear, they were happy for a moment, thinking that they could at least delay the enemy for a while. However, they did not expect that the next second, the two guardians would be beaten down.

Seeing this scene, the faces of the many secretaries and deputy secretaries who were rushing over changed, and their expressions were very solemn.

"Kasuyi hid his strength too well. His combat strength is stronger than expected!"

"Looking at all the Psychics in history, his strength is one of the best."

Just as everyone was in shock, the surveillance screen changed abruptly.

Boom!

One of the warehouses in Area 106 exploded, and powerful Supers appeared out of thin air. Without saying a word, they charged straight at the three people who were attacking.

This scene left everyone dumbfounded.

"Why is there another group?"

"Who are these guys? I don't know any of them. Could they be the attackers' accomplices? "

"It doesn't look like it. They seem to be enemies with the three attackers … They're fighting!"

"Damn it, do they think that they can enter our place whenever they want?"

Everyone was stunned, their heads full of question marks.

However, although they did not know the background of the group of powerhouses that appeared later, seeing that this group of people was blocking the attackers, they could only temporarily assume that they were friends and not enemies.

…

After the three of them defeated the obstructors, they continued to move forward. However, before the three of them reached Area 106, they felt eight powerful energy waves descend out of thin air.

Jayz narrowed his eyes. "The Guardian and its doppelgangers are here!"

Eliminating external variables was the core mechanism of the Guardian. It only had a part of the rigid preset program left. As long as it detected that an outsider appeared within a certain range of the carrier, the Guardian's main body and doppelgangers would definitely descend and kill the outsider. This was its core mechanism, and it could not be violated.

"Their appearance can change at will. I don't know which one is the main body now, but it must be inside. Give me some time to distinguish it. Otherwise, we can only try our luck."

Hearing Jayz's words, Han Xiao's eyes flickered.

"No need, I should have a way to lock onto the other party's main body."

As soon as he said that, Han Xiao released his main body's army camp. Large amounts of Mechanical Force burst out, and Mech Legion appeared one after another. The scene was like scattering beans to form soldiers, and a huge Mech Legion shot out from his body, instantly shattering the warehouse area.

His maximum health that was suppressed to five million instantly bounced back, and his energy also recovered at the same time.

"Phew, comfortable …"

With the burden lifted, Han Xiao felt his entire body relax, and all the suppressed strength was recovered.

Jayz also quickly emptied his inventory, shooting out all the machines in his body and quickly setting up the battlefield.

The next moment, eight figures appeared in his vision and rapidly approached.

Without saying anything, Han Xiao controlled the Mech Legion to cover the area with firepower. The eight figures used their own methods to hold up different types of shields, and energy shockwaves exploded in midair.

The combat information instantly flooded the screen. He opened the interface and took a quick look. The corners of his mouth curled up, and he decisively pointed at one of the figures.

"Found it. That's the main body!"

Distinguishing between real and fake was not difficult for him. The interface had long exposed the enemy's information.

"So fast?"

Jayz was stunned and almost did not react.

I haven't even seen any clues, and you've already locked onto the target? Why are you more efficient than me, a backdoor?

Jayz could not help but think of the previous three batches of outsiders. Other than the earliest batch, the other two batches had all fallen at this step. Because they could not distinguish the main body, they fell into a bitter battle and were finally annihilated by the directors of the Superpower Security Department.

The outsiders this time are much more reliable than the previous three batches, especially Black Star. In his universe iteration, he should be a famous figure …

Jayz was secretly relieved.

"I'll leave the main body to you. I'll hold back the other doppelgangers!" He did not doubt Han Xiao's judgment and directly controlled the army to entangle the seven doppelgangers.

He threw out a special targeted device, restraining the dimensional consciousness entity within the physical body. Although the other party could not violate the core mechanism, he had also taken precautions to ensure that the dimensional consciousness entity could not escape.

Han Xiao also did not hesitate. He absorbed a part of the army and transformed into a medium-sized Mechanical Deity, launching a fierce attack on the Guardian's main body. Kasuyi cooperated by the side, attacking the Guardian's main body while restraining the other seven doppelgangers, creating space for Han Xiao to attack.

The Guardian's main body was the incarnation of the dimensional consciousness entity, and it could control a portion of the dimensional energy. In order to kill the outsiders, it had temporarily created a physical body for itself. Due to the preset settings, it had extremely high combat strength, equivalent to the Supreme level combatants here. Furthermore, it was the stronger type, and its energy was inexhaustible.

Han Xiao naturally would not hold back. He went all out, and the Celestial Punishment Edge slashed open the energy shield of the Guardian's main body.

Boom!

The eleven Beyond Grade As fought fiercely, and the aftermath of the explosion directly blew the entire warehouse into pieces.

Countless debris and fragments floated in the universe. It was unknown how many unique Universal Treasures were destroyed in the explosion.

Seeing the warehouse explode, the hearts of all the upper echelons of the Superpower Security Department almost stopped, and they felt blood rush up to their throats.

"Ahhh! Kill these attackers on the spot! Don't let any of them escape! "

The eyes of the department leader instantly turned red, and he roared furiously, almost going crazy.

In the galactic space, Han Xiao was controlling the Mechanical Deity to hit the Guardian's main body again and again. At this time, his perception suddenly alerted him. He discovered that seven or eight Supreme level Secretaries were rapidly approaching, and even further away, there were dozens of Saint level Deputy Secretaries rushing over.

Before they arrived, all kinds of long-range attacks were launched, forming a colorful torrent of energy in the universe, attacking the Mechanical Deity from all angles. Amidst the brilliance, there was a fatal danger.

Even if the information showed that Black Star's physique was amazing, many of the experts present did not believe that he could withstand the attacks of dozens of people.

Han Xiao turned around and glanced at it, but he did not dodge. Instead, he suddenly threw out a strange prismatic device.

This device suddenly shook in midair, and a strange wave suddenly spread out, forming a huge spherical domain that covered the area.

The next second, the flow of time in the domain slowed down, and the members of the Superpower Security Department and their attacks all stagnated at the same time. Their movements became slow, as though they had activated a slow-motion function. Only Han Xiao, Kasuyi, and the Guardian were not affected. Even Jayz himself was affected.

This was one of the special technologies developed by Jayz, specifically targeted at this secondary dimension. It could cause the spacetime cycle in an area to be strongly disturbed, and only outsiders and dimensional consciousness entities would not be affected.

If not for this technology, the plan to attack the Superpower Security Department would have been almost impossible to succeed.

"What kind of ability is this?"

Although the movements of the members of the Superpower Security Department present had slowed down, their thoughts were still running. Their anger turned into horror, and they were all frightened by this ability.

Unable to move, they watched as the enemy ravaged their warehouse at will. Everyone's hearts were bleeding, and they felt like they were in love.
